Based on the search results, here's information about Claude Code's latest release version and changelog:

## Latest Version

The latest version of Claude Code is v2.1.289, released on October 3, 2026.

## Recent Release Highlights

Claude Code 2.1.289 includes fixes for deny or ask rules on nested shell commands, terminal freezing on short code blocks with many unclosed tags, and Read deny rules not applying to files mentioned in the IDE through a symlink.

Some other recent notable releases include:

- Version 2.1.287 (October 1, 2026) added Claude Mods, which are plugins that may now modify deeper behavior and are active by default
- Version 2.1.285 (September 29, 2026) added `claude --desktop`, `claude plugin configure`, support for bundled .mcpb servers, and an `allowedProviders` managed setting

Claude Code follows three-part version numbers and ships new builds almost daily, so updates are released very frequently with bug fixes, security patches, and new features.
